# iCompression Socks

> > A leading OEM/ODM manufacturer of custom compression socks, sports socks, and specialized hosiery with FDA, ISO 13485, and OEKO-TEX certifications.

iCompression Socks (operated by Max Hosiery/Jiaxing Max Hosiery) specializes in manufacturing custom and private-label compression socks for medical, sports, and wellness markets. The company offers comprehensive OEM/ODM services with quality certifications and bulk production capabilities for brands worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Compression Socks

- Private Label
- FDA Certified
- ISO 13485
- OEKO-TEX

- Diabetic Socks
- Bulk Production
- Quality Control
- Custom Manufacturing

- [Custom Socks Manufacturer | Compression, Grip & Sports Socks](https://www.icompressionsocks.com/custom-socks): Main custom socks manufacturing services with OEKO-TEX certification
